## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt`, `make vet`, and `make test` pass (`make test-db` if the database layer changed)
- [ ] `make generate` run and the output committed, if the web UI changed
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior, settings, or the API changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**, if a user or operator would notice
